newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Harmony ups offer to Cons Modder.
newsitem.headline: Harmony ups offer to Cons Modder.

text.p: South Africa's Harmony Gold Mining Co on Wednesday upped its offer to shareholders of Consolidated Modderfontein Mines Ltd, its fellow Randgold mine which it aims to buy.

Harmony said it would, in addition to its offer last month to Cons Modder shareholders of six Harmony shares for every 100 Cons Modder stocks held, pay a cash consideration of 10 rand for every 100 shares held.

Harmony said this new scheme values each Cons Modder share at 239 cents -- a 39 percent premium over the ruling market price of the stocks on February 14. This compares with a value of 229 cents under the earlier offer.
Upon the latest scheme becoming operative, Cons Modder will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Harmony and Cons Modder's listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange terminated.

Harmony is also in the process of bidding for Cons Modder's neighbour Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd. Should this and the Cons Modder bid be successful, it is Harmony's intention to merge the two mines' operations.
Shareholders were referred to an earlier cautionary notice of February 18 and were again advised to exercise caution in their share dealings.
